description: This file contains unit tests for the FilterSourceStream class and its subclasses, testing various filtering behaviors such as chaining, error handling, and data transformation, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: TestFilterSourceStreamBase
classes.description: Base class for testing FilterSourceStream subclasses, providing buffer management and type string handling.

classes.name: NeedsAllInputFilterSourceStream
classes.description: A filter stream that requires all input data before producing output.

classes.name: MultiplySourceStream
classes.description: A filter stream that repeats each input byte by a specified multiplier.

classes.name: PassThroughFilterSourceStream
classes.description: A filter stream that passes data through unchanged.

classes.name: ThrottleSourceStream
classes.description: A filter stream that throttles output to one byte at a time.

classes.name: NoOutputSourceStream
classes.description: A filter stream that consumes all input but produces no output.

classes.name: ErrorFilterSourceStream
classes.description: A filter stream that returns an error on FilterData.

classes.name: FilterSourceStreamTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for parameterized tests of FilterSourceStream behaviors.

methods.name: WriteBufferToOutput
methods.description: Copies data from internal buffer to output buffer, returns number of bytes written.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Virtual method overridden by subclasses to filter data.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns the type string of the stream.

methods.name: set_type_string
methods.description: Sets the type string for the stream.

methods.name: consumed_all_input
methods.description: Indicates if all input has been consumed.
